use default

let prisoners = 100
let attempts = 50
let trials = 10000

let random = System.Random(20260908)

let strategies = [
    (name = "opening at random", finds = opens_at_random),
    (name = "following the cycle", finds = follows_the_cycle)
]

shuffled_cards() -> LIST[int] =>
    (let cards = (1::prisoners) |> collect_list()
     for i in 0..cards.count do
         let j = i + random.next(cards.count - i)
         let held = cards[i]
         cards[i] = cards[j]
         cards[j] = held
     od
     cards)

follows_the_cycle(cards: LIST[int], prisoner: int) -> bool =>
    (let drawer mut = prisoner
     for _ in 0..attempts do
         if cards[drawer - 1] == prisoner then
             return true
         fi
         drawer = cards[drawer - 1]
     od
     false)

opens_at_random(cards: LIST[int], prisoner: int) -> bool =>
    (let unopened = (1::prisoners) |> collect_list()
     for i in 0..attempts do
         let j = i + random.next(unopened.count - i)
         let drawer = unopened[j]
         unopened[j] = unopened[i]
         if cards[drawer - 1] == prisoner then
             return true
         fi
     od
     false)

all_pardoned(finds: (LIST[int], int) -> bool) -> bool =>
    (let cards = shuffled_cards()
     let freed mut = 0
     while freed < prisoners /\ finds(cards, freed + 1) do
         freed = freed + 1
     od
     freed == prisoners)

success_rate(finds: (LIST[int], int) -> bool) -> double =>
    (let pardoned mut = 0
     for _ in 0..trials do
         if all_pardoned(finds) then
             pardoned = pardoned + 1
         fi
     od
     cast(pardoned) * 100.0D / cast(trials))

write_line("{trials} trials of {prisoners} prisoners "
           "opening {attempts} drawers each")

for (name, finds) in strategies do
    write_line("{name}: {success_rate(finds):F2}%")
od
